description: A Next.js chat route destructures the model name from the request body (`const { messages, model } = await req.json()`) and passes it straight to OpenAI on the server's own API key. Any signed-in user can pick the most expensive model, or any model the key can reach, by editing the request. VC028 must fire on the destructuring line. It used to miss this: it only recognised the member-access form `model: req.body.model`, not the destructured shape route handlers and Express apps actually use.
